<p style="text-align: justify;">
This page runs real Python — with NumPy and Matplotlib — entirely inside your browser. Pick an example from the course, edit it, and press <strong>Run</strong>. It is perfect for quick experiments between lectures; for full weekly notebooks, use the [course page](courses/pnm/index.qmd) and its Colab links.
</p>

```{=html}
<style>
.pg-root {
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;

  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem 1.25rem; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
}

  font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid #e1e0d9; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #0b0b0b;
}

  background: #7a2318; color: #f5efe6; border: none; border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.45rem 1.1rem; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
}

  width: 100%; min-height: 240px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #e1e0d9; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem; background: #fcfcfb; color: #0b0b0b; resize: vertical; white-space: pre; overflow-x: auto;
}
.pg-editor:focus { outline: 2px solid rgba(163,58,42,0.35); }
.pg-out {
  margin-top: 0.7rem; background: #1f1e1c; color: #e8e6e0; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 2.2rem; max-height: 340px; overflow: auto;
}

<div class="pg-root" id="pg">
  <div class="pg-toolbar">
    <select id="pg-example" aria-label="Load an example">
      <option value="hello">Example: first steps</option>
      <option value="pv">Exercise: present value (Week 1)</option>
      <option value="solow">Example: Solow growth model (Week 1)</option>
      <option value="loops">Exercise: even numbers (Week 1)</option>
      <option value="ces">Exercise: CES production (Week 2)</option>
      <option value="blank">Blank editor</option>
    </select>

  </div>

  <p class="pg-note">Runs entirely in your browser via <a href="https://pyodide.org">Pyodide</a> (Python 3 + NumPy + Matplotlib compiled to WebAssembly). Nothing is sent to a server. Keyboard: <b>Ctrl/Cmd + Enter</b> to run. For full notebooks, use the Colab links on the course page.</p>
</div>

<script>
const PG_EXAMPLES = {
hello: `# Welcome! Edit this code and press Run (or Ctrl+Enter).
gdp = 2.85e12
population = 68_350_000
print(f"GDP per capita: {gdp/population:,.2f}")

# Greek letters work:
α, β = 0.3, 0.96
print("α + β =", α + β)`,
pv: `# Exercise (Week 1): write present_value(payment, r, T)
# PV = sum of payment/(1+r)**t for t = 1..T
# Check: present_value(100, 0.05, 10) should be ≈ 772.17

def present_value(payment, r, T):
    ...  # your code here

print(present_value(100, 0.05, 10))`,
solow: `# The Solow growth model — k(t+1) = s*k(t)**α + (1-δ)*k(t)
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def solow_path(s=0.25, alpha=0.3, delta=0.05, k0=1.0, T=100):
    k = np.zeros(T); k[0] = k0
    for t in range(T-1):
        k[t+1] = s*k[t]**alpha + (1-delta)*k[t]
    return k

k = solow_path()
k_star = (0.25/0.05)**(1/(1-0.3))

plt.figure(figsize=(7,3.5))
plt.plot(k, lw=2, label="capital path")
plt.axhline(k_star, ls="--", c="tab:red", label="steady state")
plt.xlabel("t"); plt.ylabel("k"); plt.legend()
plt.title("Try changing s or delta and re-running!")
plt.show()`,
loops: `# Exercise (Week 1): count the even numbers in 0–99
# Hint: x % 2 == 0 tests evenness; booleans add as 1/0.

count = 0
# your loop here

print(count)   # should print 50`,
ces: `# Exercise (Week 2): CES production function
# Y = A*(α*K**ρ + (1-α)*L**ρ)**(1/ρ),  ρ = (σ-1)/σ
# ces(4, 9) with defaults should be ≈ 6.25

def ces(K, L, alpha=0.5, sigma=2.0, A=1.0):
    ...  # your code here

print(ces(4, 9))`,
blank: `# Your Python scratchpad — numpy and matplotlib are available.
`};

(function(){
  const runBtn = document.getElementById('pg-run');
  const status = document.getElementById('pg-status');
  const codeEl = document.getElementById('pg-code');
  const outEl  = document.getElementById('pg-out');
  const figEl  = document.getElementById('pg-fig');
  const exSel  = document.getElementById('pg-example');

  codeEl.value = PG_EXAMPLES.hello;
  exSel.addEventListener('change', () => { codeEl.value = PG_EXAMPLES[exSel.value]; outEl.textContent = 'Output will appear here.'; figEl.innerHTML=''; });
  codeEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); if(!runBtn.disabled) run(); }
    if (e.key === 'Tab'){ e.preventDefault();
      const s = codeEl.selectionStart; codeEl.setRangeText('    ', s, codeEl.selectionEnd, 'end'); }
  });

  let pyodide = null, loading = null;

  async function ensurePyodide(){
    if (pyodide) return pyodide;
    if (!loading){
      loading = (async () => {
        const CDNS = [
          "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.26.4/full/",
          "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pyodide/0.26.4/"
        ];
        let mod = null, base = null;
        for (const c of CDNS){
          try { mod = await import(c + "pyodide.mjs"); base = c; break; } catch(e){ console.warn("CDN failed:", c); }
        }
        if (!mod) throw new Error("no CDN reachable");
        const py = await mod.loadPyodide({indexURL: base});
        status.textContent = "Loading NumPy + Matplotlib…";
        await py.loadPackage(["numpy", "matplotlib"]);
        await py.runPythonAsync(`
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("AGG")
import sys, io, base64
`);
        return py;
      })();
    }
    pyodide = await loading;
    return pyodide;
  }

  // start loading immediately
  ensurePyodide().then(() => {
    runBtn.disabled = false;
    status.textContent = "Python ready ✓";
  }).catch(e => {
    status.textContent = "Could not load Python (check your connection).";
    console.error(e);
  });

  async function run(){
    runBtn.disabled = true; status.textContent = "Running…";
    outEl.textContent = ""; figEl.innerHTML = "";
    try {
      const py = await ensurePyodide();
      py.globals.set("__code__", codeEl.value);
      const result = await py.runPythonAsync(`
import sys, io, base64, traceback
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_buf = io.StringIO()
_old = sys.stdout
sys.stdout = _buf
_err = None
try:
    exec(compile(__code__, "<playground>", "exec"), {})
except Exception:
    _err = traceback.format_exc(limit=3)
finally:
    sys.stdout = _old
_figs = []
for _n in plt.get_fignums():
    _f = plt.figure(_n)
    _b = io.BytesIO()
    _f.savefig(_b, format="png", dpi=110, bbox_inches="tight")
    _figs.append(base64.b64encode(_b.getvalue()).decode())
plt.close("all")
import json
json.dumps({"out": _buf.getvalue(), "err": _err, "figs": _figs})
`);
      const r = JSON.parse(result);
      if (r.out) outEl.textContent = r.out;
      if (r.err){ const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className='err'; s.textContent = r.err; outEl.appendChild(s); }
      if (!r.out && !r.err) outEl.textContent = "(no output — use print())";
      for (const f of r.figs){
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = "data:image/png;base64," + f;
        img.alt = "Matplotlib figure";
        figEl.appendChild(img);
      }
      status.textContent = "Python ready ✓";
    } catch(e){
      outEl.innerHTML = '<span class="err">' + String(e) + '</span>';
      status.textContent = "Python ready ✓";
    }
    runBtn.disabled = false;
  }
  runBtn.addEventListener('click', run);
})();
</script>

```
